question: Which released clone distribution is actually drawn in Fig. 2i, and does the published display convention explain the reported two-sided P?
decision: Resolve the Fig. 2i denominator and t-test discrepancy if supported by physical marks. Otherwise retain the discrepancy. S2 only.
strongest_rival: Figure display clipping and different clone eligibility may account for the caption and P discrepancies. A visually close distribution cannot identify individual clone labels or establish the authors' t-test input.
discriminator: Count independent two-dimensional glyphs by history, calibrate scores at actual axis ticks and compare sorted plotted versus released values and crossbars. Report all prespecified tests.
exposure_record: After primary S2, all Fig. 2h-i release results and the difference between full and >=5 high fractions were known. Inspection found 123 vector circle paths in the Fig. 2i plot, axes labelled beyond +/-1.5, tick/crossbar geometry and P=0.038. Sorted point comparisons and clipped t-tests have not been computed.
biological_unit: One plotted symbol per displayed clone statistic; release history-by-clone observations nest within six donor lines. Plot symbol counts do not increase the number of independent mice.
nesting_and_overlap: 4,815 scored memberships from 4,193 unique cells, 585 cells in multiple scored clones. Tokens can cross lines/histories. Verified six donors, one per line, no pairing. Reused data are not independent validation.
population_and_selection: All four-cubic filled circle paths inside Fig. 2i on PDF page 4; compare against the full released and >=5-membership (history, clone) tables from the frozen S2 run. The y-axis explicitly clips the tails.
contrast: Within-history rank-level calibration and crossbar differences, only when counts agree. Three descriptive Welch and equal-variance comparisons apply to raw, display-clipped and glyph-estimated values for the equal-size comparison.
endpoint: Per-history glyph count and calibrated median crossbar; rank-level source and clipped scores, per-score discrepancies and conventional two-sided t-test readbacks.
methods: Recover circle centers by vector geometry with PyMuPDF. Separate history by x position and calibrate y with the zero and +/-1 ticks. Compare sorted distributions (no per-clone identities in PDF), clip only the released values used for comparison with the display at +/-1.5. Report discrepancies on the score scale; absolute 0.015 is a prechosen graphics tolerance of <0.5 PDF pt. Compare P to three-decimal published precision, preserving all variants. Provenance of the author test still requires a test script or inputs.
missingness_and_exclusions: No count matching by dropping extra points from a group. No extrapolation of out-of-range tail values from the graphical cap. Crossbar and rank matching do not assign clone identity.
multiplicity: Graphical fidelity audit and two two-sided test conventions on three fixed inputs; no new biological hypothesis tests.
precision_basis: PDF coordinates given in points. One unit of accessibility spans about 30 PDF pt; discrepancy tolerance 0.015 score is for graphics calibration only.
interpretation_limit: A reproduced printed P or matched distribution identifies a compatible convention, not the original executable or proof of an independent history effect.
stop_rule: Stop on ambiguous geometry or calibration. Preserve unmatched quantiles or P; do not search additional thresholds, transforms or tests.
amendment_reason: Separate exposed figure-discrepancy diagnostic. Retains the original S2 contract and run.
